Boundaries.Name: typed-dispatch-owner
Boundaries.Contract: Immediately admitted ordinary standalone commands transfer final ownership directly to native converted inspection, including conversion and cleanup. All other paths start dispatch ownership before disposal, route selection, command validation and cache fences. Replica/cluster routes, capacity waits and transparent retries borrow the generation-bound dispatch owner.

Boundaries.Name: string-dispatch-owner
Boundaries.Contract: Immediately admitted ordinary standalone commands return native string inspection as final owner. Other string dispatch owns preflight through response consumption; ready routes and transparent retries borrow the same failure-only dispatch lease.

Boundaries.Name: bytes-dispatch-owner
Boundaries.Contract: Immediately admitted ordinary standalone commands return native byte inspection as final owner. Other byte dispatch owns preflight through response consumption; copied discarded-reply metadata outlives either caller owner.
